catches: Choose one: $150 account credit (three $50 credits after 1st/2nd/3rd delivery) OR 25c/gal Irving Rewards retail offer (up to 20-gal limit per visit, 42 visits/24 months) — cannot combine.
Free one-year Labor Plan ($252 stated value) requires an eligible heating system and begins at first fuel delivery.
Must purchase all fuel for primary home heating system from Irving on automatic delivery; account must stay in good standing.
New residential propane/heating-oil customers in Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont only, in Irving-served areas; offer ends December 31, 2026.
Fuel pricing varies; the credit does not guarantee the plan beats the utility rate.
